title: On the additive index of the Diffie-Hellman mapping and the discrete logarithm
summary: Several complexity measures such as degree, sparsity and multiplicative index for cryptographic functions including the Diffie-Hellman mapping and the discrete logarithm in a finite field have been studied in the literature. In 2022, Reis and Wang introduced another complexity measure, the additive index, of a self-mapping of a finite field. In this paper, under certain conditions, we determine lower bounds on the additive index of the univariate Diffie-Hellman mapping and a self-mapping of $\mathbb{F}_q$ which can be identified with the discrete logarithm in a finite field.
